name: arifOS Federation Observability Authority Graph
doctrine: Four-Layer Separation of Power & Reality-Bound Authority

Sovereign.scope: All federation organs, schemas, deployments, financial boundaries, and constitutional ratifications.
Sovereign.cannot_delegate_to: Autonomous agents without explicit protocol seal

powers: Probe organ health via HTTP GET
Publish alerts to SIGNAL or Hermes when blindness/drift occurs
forbidden_actions: Never execute code or system mutations
Never block or throttle traffic (no gatekeeper role)
Never act as judge of agent intent (only reports observed delta against baseline)

powers: Enforce HOLD on actors with execution dominance or FQ divergence
forbidden_actions: Cannot mutate file system or deployment configurations
Cannot alter constitutional floors (only enforces thresholds)

powers: Persist structured observation records to Postgres
Expose read-only stream and database queries
forbidden_actions: Cannot reject valid payloads based on narrative
Cannot alter payload contents during ingestion
Cannot execute downstream actions based on telemetry content

powers: Evaluate action proposals against F1-F13 floors
forbidden_actions: Cannot execute mutations directly (delegates to A-FORGE)

powers: Execute authorized shell and deployment scripts
forbidden_actions: Cannot bypass arifFLOW rate limits when held
